criterion: Coordinator item 4 (2026-10-21): the showcase timings become the shading pass's own time, not wall times that include setup.
written: 2026-10-21, before any run of the timer
design: gpu_check::shadeOnGpu with a DispatchTiming: after the end-to-end run (uploads, pipelines, readback), each chunk's dispatch is recorded alone, submitted and waited for 21 times; the frame's time is the sum over chunks of each chunk's median submit-to-fence time. This is a CPU clock around submit and fence, not GPU timestamp queries (the general RHI has none yet; the HW workstream's queue does), so it includes submission and fence latency.

t1_excludes_setup.what: material-gallery --field on the RTX 4090 at 256 x 160
t1_excludes_setup.bound: dispatch_ms at most a fifth of wall_ms
t1_excludes_setup.prediction: holds by far: the earlier wall time was 3.98 s

t3_scales.what: 1920 x 1080 at 1 sample a pixel against 256 x 160 at 4 (about 14 times the samples)
t3_scales.bound: the dispatch time ratio between 4 and 30
t3_scales.prediction: about 8 to 14: small frames carry fixed latency

t4_recorded.what: the sphere field's shading-pass frame time at 1080p on the RTX 4090 and on WARP

does_not_prove: GPU time without submission latency (needs timestamp queries in the RHI); the frame time of a whole renderer (only the shading pass is timed).
